dataset_title: DeepGuard Supplementary Workplace Portrait Dataset (Specification & Manifest)
objective: Mitigate domain shift and ImageNet semantic prior bias (laptops/office furniture) causing false negatives on modern AI-generated office portraits.

hardware_requirements.recommended: NVIDIA T4 or RTX 3060 (16GB RAM, ~15-20 minutes)

real_sources.verification: EXIF camera metadata check (ISO, shutter, camera model) to ensure authentic optical capture
Photographer attribution and original sensor noise validation

fake_sources.domain_focus: Photorealistic office, corporate executive, person working on laptop
High-fidelity modern office portraits with complex lighting and hands/laptops
Workplace portraits with varied office backgrounds
Photorealistic portraits of professionals with laptops

leakage_prevention_protocol.subject_grouping: All images of the same individual, same prompt seed, or same photographer session MUST be grouped into the same split.
leakage_prevention_protocol.perceptual_hash_deduplication: Every candidate image is filtered using ImageHash (pHash) with threshold Hamming distance < 6 to eliminate near-duplicate crops.

quarantined_benchmark_cases.rationale: Strictly quarantined in held-out test split to guarantee out-of-sample evaluation parity. Never used in train or validation.

schema_definition.label: 'REAL' | 'FAKE'
schema_definition.generator_or_source: Source platform or generative model family
schema_definition.subject_group_id: Unique ID grouping related session assets
